rows.grounds: absolutive form of the root jñā (to know)
compound adjective in accusative singular masculine
abstract noun in nominative singular neuter
present middle third singular of prajā (to be born or arise)

items.question: What arises when one knows the hidden true nature of that?
premises: Knowing hidden true nature causes all-knowingness.
That refers to the prior divine lord.
items.inference: All-knowingness arises from knowing the hidden true nature.
uncertainties: The exact referent of taṃ depends on the preceding verse.
items.plain_english: Having known that hidden true nature, all-knowingness arises.
